definitions.explanation: Having lived or existed for only a short time.

examples.english: I traveled a lot when I was young.

examples.english: The company has many young employees, so the atmosphere is bright and lively.

notes:
{若|わか}い is an i-adjective meaning "young," typically describing people but also applicable to organizations or things.

FORMS:
- Adverb: {若|わか}く ({若|わか}く{見|み}える - to look young)
- Noun form: {若|わか}さ (youth, youthfulness)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {若|わか}い{頃|ころ}/{時|とき}: when (someone was) young
- {若|わか}い{人|ひと}/{者|もの}: young person
- {若|わか}い{世代|せだい}: younger generation
- まだ{若|わか}い: still young

RELATED WORDS:
- {若者|わかもの}: young person, youth
- {若返|わかがえ}る: to become younger, rejuvenate

USAGE:
Unlike English "young," {若|わか}い is rarely used for very small children - {小|ちい}さい or specific age terms are preferred. {若|わか}い often implies teenage to early 30s.
